mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE authorized_menus AS ( SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.code, m.name, m.display_name, m.icon, m.path, m.component, m.permission_name, m.parent_id, m.sort_order, m.is_enabled, m.is_hidden, m.tenant_id, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.is_deleted FROM whale_menus m INNER JOIN whale_permissions p ON m.permission_name = p.name AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN whale_permission_grants pg ON pg.permission_name = p.name AND pg.provider_name = 'R' AND pg.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN whale_roles r ON r.id = pg.provider_key AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_enabled = 1 AND (r.id IN #{role} OR r.code IN #{role} OR r.name IN #{role} )
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT parent.id, parent.code, parent.name, parent.display_name, parent.icon, parent.path, parent.component, parent.permission_name, parent.parent_id, parent.sort_order, parent.is_enabled, parent.is_hidden, parent.tenant_id, parent.created_at, parent.updated_at, parent.is_deleted FROM whale_menus parent INNER JOIN authorized_menus child ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE parent.is_deleted = 0 AND parent.is_enabled = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT * FROM authorized_menus ORDER BY sort_order, id
